meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会持续盯住一个 PR:查看 CI 检查、评论和未解决的 review 线程,发现真实问题就提交修复并推送,然后重新检查;直到检查通过、没有待处理评论和未解决线程才停手。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、monitor,或持续检查 PR 的评论、review 与 CI,直到可处理问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit PR #123,直到它达到可合并状态
say.note: 它会轮询 CI、评论和 review 线程

say.text: 盯着这个 PR 的 CI 和 review 评论,有问题就修
say.note: 发现真实问题会提交修复并推送

say.text: 看看 PR #123 还有哪些未解决的 review 线程
say.note: 列出来源、文件、行号和最后一条评论

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching a PR: it checks CI, comments, and unresolved review threads, commits and pushes fixes for real issues, then rechecks. It stops only when checks pass and no actionable comments or unresolved threads remain.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Polls CI, comments, and review threads

say_en.text: Watch this PR's CI and review comments, fix what breaks.
say_en.note: Commits and pushes fixes for real issues

say_en.text: Check PR #123 for unresolved review threads.
say_en.note: Lists path, line, and last comment
